'''Koss Overlook''' was a ridge that divided the [[Gormak Lands]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]], extending south from the upper hills of the region toward [[Gorma-Koss]]. The [[Voss commando outpost]] was located at the southern end of the ridge.
